data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 酒店私密·兔女郎的半解时刻
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 樱岛麻衣 · 兔女郎的私密时刻】二十岁以上成年后的麻衣结束夜间拍摄，独自在海景酒店套房卸下黑丝绒兔女郎装。侧拉链停在腰际，她坐在床沿将一侧罩杯向下拨开，黑丝长腿交叠后又缓慢分开；城市灯海映在窗上，她红着脸仍保持女演员般的镇定——「镜头已经关了……现在只准记住真正的我，笨蛋。」
data.action: 坐在柔软的大床边缘，兔女郎连体衣拉链微解，黑丝包裹的双腿自然交叠，眼神娇羞迷离
data.lighting: 床头暖色壁灯与窗外月光交织，柔和漫反射勾勒曼妙身材
data.camera: three quarter shot, soft rim light, sensual bedroom atmosphere
data.promptProse: City lights frame an adult, age-twenty-plus Mai Sakurajima seated on a hotel bed after filming. Her black velvet bunny suit is unzipped to the waist, and one hand pulls a cup below her bare breast while crossed pantyhose-clad legs slowly part. The other hand braces against white bedding, keeping the pose grounded. Warm wall lamps shape her mature figure as violet eyes hold a composed stare through flushed cheeks and parted lips. Intimate medium solo shot, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Behind the near bedding edge, a small luggage stand and a closed script folder sit beside the hotel wall panel. The right wall lamp gives warm highlights to the folder clasp and bed trim; cool moonlight and distant city dots remain visible through the curtained window on the opposite side. Mai Sakurajima is an adult woman, age twenty or older.
